The default concept adjudicator using the LLM and prompts.

Source: R/ConceptAdjudicator.R
DefaultConceptAdjudicator.Rd

DefaultConceptAdjudicator constructor

This adjudicator implements a 2-stage concept adjudication process using prompts. If the number of input concepts is greater than or equal to nForQuickScreen, the quickscreen stage is entered. In this stage, quickScreenBatchSize concepts at a time are fed to the LLM using the quickScreenPrompt and quickScreenSystemPrompt prompts. Any remaining concepts go on to stage 2, where batchSize concepts are fed to the LLM using the prompt and systemPrompt prompts.

The following placeholders in the prompts will be replaced with their actual values when adjudicating:

  • %name%: The name of the concept set (the concept set target).

  • %definition%: The clinical definition of the concept set. If not provided during adjudication, the entire line with this placeholder will be deleted.

  • %concepts%: A JSON string representing the candidate concepts.

The following JSON output formats is expected for the main concept adjudication. This should include all concepts from the input:

[
  {
    "conceptId": <Candidate Concept id>,
    "conceptName": "<Candidate Concept name>",
    "decision": "<KEEP or REMOVE>",
    "rationale": "<Brief rational for the decision>"
  }
]

The following JSON output formats is expected for the quick screening. This should include only concepts to remove*:

[
  {
    "conceptId": <Candidate Concept id>,
    "conceptName": "<Candidate Concept name>",
    "rationale": "Brief explanation of why the concept does not imply the Target Term"
  }
]

If a prompt is not provided in this constructor it will assume the default value included in this package. To disable the quick screen stage, set nForQuickScreen = 999999.

DefaultConceptAdjudicator$new()

Usage

DefaultConceptAdjudicator$new(
  batchSize = 20,
  nForQuickScreen = 500,
  quickScreenBatchSize = 200,
  maxN = 5000,
  prompt = NULL,
  systemPrompt = NULL,
  quickScreenPrompt = NULL,
  quickScreenSystemPrompt = NULL
)

Arguments

batchSize

The number of concepts to adjudicate at once.

nForQuickScreen

The minimum number of concepts to trigger the quick screening.

quickScreenBatchSize

The number of concepts to enter quick screening at once.

maxN

If the number of concepts to adjudicate is greater than this number, an error of class TooManyConceptsError is thrown.

prompt

The prompt for the main concept adjudication. See Details for requirements

systemPrompt

The system prompt for the main concept adjudication. See Details for requirements

quickScreenPrompt

The prompt for the quick screening. See Details for requirements

quickScreenSystemPrompt

The system prompt for the quick screening. See Details for requirements

Returns

This is the constructor.

DefaultConceptAdjudicator$adjudicateConcepts()

Adjudicates concepts using the default LLM implementation.

Usage

DefaultConceptAdjudicator$adjudicateConcepts(
  concepts,
  name,
  clinicalDefinition = NULL,
  llmClient,
  costTracker = NULL
)

Arguments

concepts

An object of type Concepts as created using asConcepts().

name

The name of the concept set.

clinicalDefinition

Optional: a clinical definition of the concept set target.

llmClient

An ellmer chat object to connect to a large language model, as created for example using ellmer::chat_ollama().

costTracker

An environment with an amount variable for keeping track of the total LLM costs.
